sources.title: Malicious ML models discovered on Hugging Face platform
sources.snippet: In the case of the discovered model, since the malicious payload is inserted at the beginning of the Pickle stream, execution of the model wouldn't be detected as unsafe by Hugging Face's existing security scanning tools. Protect your ML models RL is constantly improving its malware detection mechanisms.
